assessments.reasoning: ECMA-262 15th edition §10.1.8.1 steps 1 and 2.a–c jointly establish the normal own-property miss and normal prototype lookup, the null result, and a call to the non-null parent internal Get using the original P and Receiver. The question-mark operations can propagate abrupt completion. Steps 3–7 apply to an existing data or accessor descriptor, including undefined data and a missing getter. The algorithm is governing for the scoped operation.

challenge.method: Traced the governing algorithm branches and ran ecma-controls.js in Node.js v24.4.1. Probed null prototype, delegation to a prototype with a distinct explicit receiver and a symbol key, propagation of a delegated exception, and shadowing with an own undefined-valued data property or a setter-only accessor.
challenge.results: The null branch returned undefined. The inherited lookup took the original key and receiver and propagated the exact thrown object. The two existing own descriptors suppressed delegation. The specification also routes abrupt completion from either prerequisite operation outside the stated condition.

limitations: Node.js v24.4.1 provides a behavioral control. The normative finding rests on the pinned 15th-edition specification.
